name: goldilocks
description: A Superpowers-compatible workflow suite with dynamic hierarchical orchestration and constant quality standards.

interface.longDescription: Provides thirteen familiar workflow entries plus a Goldilocks router backed by six shared engines. It dynamically chooses Direct, Lead-to-Fast, Lead-to-Standard, or Lead-to-Standard-to-Fast execution; uses explicit native models or a packaged Spark CLI worker; minimizes quota-weighted expensive work within a raw-token envelope; preserves continuity; and keeps final review and integration with Lead.
defaultPrompt: Use the smallest workflow that preserves full quality.
Plan and execute this with the shallowest useful agent hierarchy.
Keep Lead focused on direction and integration; delegate complete execution contracts to lower-cost workers and replace Superpowers entries when applicable.
